propositions: Any single mapped project's base-query transport error (ACLI 4xx/5xx, timeout, rate-limit, permission denied, unknown-project) currently aborts the entire reconciler pass for all projects.
The base-query loop lacks per-project error isolation, unlike the downstream enrichment loop which fails open per-project.
A syntactically-valid but nonexistent project key (e.g. LEG) causes ACLI exit 1, terminating all scheduled passes and causing multi-hour production outage.

The fix extracts _fetch_project helper to drain both base queries into a local dict, wraps it in per-project try/except, and merges to shared snapshot only on success, preventing partial/empty reads from leaking as deletions.
Per-project transport failures emit fetcher-project-fetch-failed alert with project key and pass_id, then continue processing other projects.
Invalid project keys fail closed (validation outside try/except) and BackendPaginationStallError re-raises (fail loud), preserving existing fail-closed semantics.
